defects: The constant-rank hypothesis is vacuous: `∀ q, Ideal.IsPrime q → ∃ (k : ℕ), True` is trivially true for any q (the existential body is `True`), so it encodes no actual constraint on rank at all, let alone that rankAtStalk is constant and equal to rankAtStalk at p across maximal ideals — this is the core mathematical content of the theorem and it is missing.
M is required to be an AddCommMonoid rather than AddCommGroup, weakening/changing the algebraic structure expected of a module.

Conclusion is phrased via M ⊗[R] Localization.Away a R rather than LocalizedModule.Away a M; while localization can be expressed as a tensor product, the produced signature 'Localization.Away a R' incorrectly supplies R as an explicit argument to Localization.Away, which does not take the ring as a separate parameter.

hfinite and hflat are stated as ordinary hypotheses (Module.Finite R M, Module.Flat R M) rather than as instances, and hprime as Ideal.IsPrime p rather than the instance [p.IsPrime] — a stylistic difference but combined with the other issues indicates a generally loose transcription.
